title: Minimizing Waste from Electropolishing Radioactive Samples for EBSD Data Collection.
content: Detailed microstructural analysis generally requires careful metallographic preparation and polishing. Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) in particular requires a very high-quality polish typically only attainable using both large amounts of water (mechanical polishing) and harsh chemicals (electropolishing or vibratory polishing). When combined with radioactive material, these methods can generate mixed waste or large quantities of contaminated water. A method to polish radioactive or contaminated material that uses neither acid nor water could reduce waste streams to purely the level of associated radioactivity i.e. low-level waste.
